scripts.build: npm run build:blocks && npm run build:resources
scripts.build:resources: rm -rf build/resources && wp-scripts build resources/event-meta-fields/index.js --output-path=build/resources/event-meta-fields && wp-scripts build resources/organiser-fields/index.js --output-path=build/resources/organiser-fields && wp-scripts build resources/filtered-count/index.js --output-path=build/resources/filtered-count
scripts.start: npm run start:blocks & npm run start:resources
scripts.start:resources: rm -rf build/resources && (wp-scripts start resources/event-meta-fields/index.js --output-path=build/resources/event-meta-fields & wp-scripts start resources/organiser-fields/index.js --output-path=build/resources/organiser-fields & wp-scripts start resources/filtered-count/index.js --output-path=build/resources/filtered-count)
